import Mathlib
open Function Fintype Subgroup Ideal Polynomial Submodule Zsqrtd
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Artin_exercise_6_8_1 {G : Type*} [Group G]
  (a b : G) : closure ({a, b} : Set G) = Subgroup.closure {b*a*b^2, b*a*b^3} := by
  let K : Subgroup G := Subgroup.closure ({a, b} : Set G)
  let H : Subgroup G := Subgroup.closure ({b*a*b^2, b*a*b^3} : Set G)
  change K = H
  apply _root_.le_antisymm
  · apply (Subgroup.closure_le H).2
    intro x hx
    have hx' : b * a * b^2 ∈ H :=
      Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
    have hy' : b * a * b^3 ∈ H :=
      Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
    have hb : b ∈ H := by
      have h := H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem hx') hy'
      convert h using 1 <;> group
    have ha : a ∈ H := by
      have h := H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem hb) hx')
        (H.inv_mem (H.pow_mem hb 2))
      convert h using 1 <;> group
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact ha
    · exact hb
  · apply (Subgroup.closure_le K).2
    intro x hx
    have ha : a ∈ K :=
      Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
    have hb : b ∈ K :=
      Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact K.mul_mem (K.mul_mem hb ha) (K.pow_mem hb 2)
    · exact K.mul_mem (K.mul_mem hb ha) (K.pow_mem hb 3)
